maddeler.e:
اعتذرن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرْنَ (iʕtaḏarna) /iʕ.ta.ðar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرْنَ (uʕtuḏirna) /uʕ.tu.ðir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اِعْتَذِرْنَ (iʕtaḏirna) /iʕ.ta.ðir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
